id: title:Gilbert09:survive a team deleted mid table size calculation

review.posthog_relevance: Protects warehouse ingestion workflow from database row deletion races during long S3 listing, preventing unhandled DatabaseError exceptions and allowing early exit if the team or table was deleted concurrently.
review.reason: Adds DatabaseError handling and row existence checks to warehouse ingestion workflow, wrapping database save operations with try/except and asserting clean exit when team is deleted during long S3 listing. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for warehouse ingestion reliability.
review.uncertainty: Cannot independently verify actual production incidents or adoption; score relies solely on observed code implementation and test assertions.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected.

observations.behavior: Adds DatabaseError to imports and wraps two database save operations with try/except DatabaseError, checking if the row still exists before re-raising.
observations.posthog_connection: Protects the warehouse ingestion workflow from database row deletion races while the activity performs a long S3 listing, preventing unhandled DatabaseError exceptions and allowing early exit if the team or table was deleted concurrently.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting the workflow exits cleanly and rows are absent when the team is deleted during the long S3 listing, rather than raising an exception.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression test coverage for the race condition between team deletion and warehouse ingestion, ensuring the workflow does not fail unexpectedly when the owning team is removed while the activity is running.
